text.p: Franco-Nevada Mining Corp Ltd and Euro-Nevada Mining Corp Ltd said on Wednesday in separate statements that they were proposing two-for-one share splits.
Franco-Nevada said it initiated the split for the development of existing properties such as Midas and Hemlo, plus new acquisitions of royalties and properties.

Euro-Nevada it initiated the split as a result of the company's plan for continued growth through the development of its 50 percent owned Midas property in Nevada, the Meikle, Getchell and Eskay Creek royalty properties in North America, as well as its rapidly developing Pacific-Nevada subsidiary.
Franco-Nevada and Euro-Nevada have individual and shared royalty interests in gold mining ventures.
